name: Stockkeeper — Inventory Manager for WooCommerce
author: Dimdul

sections.description:
Stockkeeper gives WooCommerce store owners one screen to see and control all of their stock. Instead of opening each product to change a number, manage everything from a fast, filterable dashboard — and get notified before you run out.

Features

  • Central stock dashboard — view every product and variation with live stock, SKU and status.
  • Inline editing — update stock on the spot with instant AJAX saving.
  • Search and filters — filter by low stock, out of stock, in stock, on backorder, or stock-managed only.
  • At-a-glance KPIs — managed products, in stock, low stock, and out of stock counts.
  • Low-stock email alerts — scheduled digests when products run low or sell out.
  • Audit log — a complete history of every stock change: who, when, before, after, and why.
  • CSV export — download your current stock for spreadsheets or backups.
  • HPOS compatible — works with WooCommerce custom order tables and cart/checkout blocks.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the stockkeeper folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install through Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to Stockkeeper in the admin menu to manage your stock.
sections.faq:
Does it replace WooCommerce stock?

No. Stockkeeper keeps WooCommerce’s native stock as the source of truth and mirrors every change, so your themes, reports, and other plugins keep working exactly as before.

Will my orders update stock correctly?

Yes. Every order-driven stock change is captured and recorded in the audit log with the order reference.

Is it compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes. Stockkeeper reads orders only through the WooCommerce CRUD API and declares HPOS compatibility.

Does this plugin require an external service?

No. Stockkeeper runs entirely on your WordPress site. Email alerts use your site’s configured mail settings.
